summary: Four LiveView modules that surface Barkpark's content and plugin infrastructure as real-time browser UIs: a streaming paper reader (Bulldocs), a public read-only sheet viewer, and two admin LiveViews for managing and debugging plugins without SSH access.

intentions.title: Zero-reload live content reading
intentions.evidence: BulldocsLive implements a two-path renderer (block-streamed Wave 4 + HTML-only Wave 3 fallback) with PubSub subscriptions, rev-gap recovery via full refetch, and a DOM sentinel that proves no page reload occurred across delta updates. SheetsReaderLive subscribes to Session delta topic and forwards ops into SheetGrid in read_only mode, showing live edits as they happen.

intentions.title: Plugin system operability without SSH
intentions.evidence: PluginsLive exposes per-plugin callback coverage, bootstrap/seed run status, and idempotent in-process Reload without restarting Phoenix. PluginSettingsLive provides a secure settings form (encrypted at rest, audit-logged) with Reveal/Clear/Test-connection actions, replacing manual `mix run` or SSH sessions for credential management.

intentions.title: Paperflow orchestrator bridge via Barkpark events
intentions.evidence: BulldocsLive's action buttons (Create plan, Grill, Build, Submit, Simplify) record user intent as `paper_events` rows (routing Option B) scoped to the paper's workspace/project, letting the paperflow orchestrator pick up user decisions without a daemon or CLAUDE_TARGET nonce.

intentions.title: Goal-path lifecycle visibility inside published papers
intentions.evidence: BulldocsLive mounts a sticky goal-path rail rendering a Mermaid gitGraph of `kind:event` Barkpark tasks for the paper's goal_id, with shift-click diff modal (TextDiff line diff of two event payloads) — surfacing the paperflow Goal history inside the reading surface.

intentions.title: Multi-tenant isolation for paper reads and events
intentions.evidence: BulldocsLive resolves reader_scope from URL params (/w/:ws/p/:proj/papers/:slug vs flat /papers/:slug), subscribes to workspace-keyed PubSub topics, and stamps all recorded events with the paper's own workspace_id/project_id — preventing cross-tenant PubSub leakage and event pollution.

intentions.title: Plugin secrets security model
intentions.evidence: PluginSettingsLive never serialises stored secrets into the DOM; password fields render empty with a masked badge; Reveal is a separate explicit action; blank password submission preserves existing encrypted value; every read/write/reveal/delete is audit-logged in plugin_settings_audits.

intentions.title: Published-only public content surfaces
intentions.evidence: Both BulldocsLive (via get_public_paper) and SheetsReaderLive (via get_public_document + NotFound exception for draft-only slugs) enforce that public reader routes only resolve against published documents in the seeded Default workspace.
